lines.en: I am pushed toward the gate.

lines.zh: 木轮碾过碎石,一路闷响
lines.en: My wheels grind over rubble.
The heavy log hangs in my frame.

lines.zh: 我走的是最短的一条线
lines.en: I take the shortest line.
The men behind me shout the pace.
I sway once, then steady.
My wheels sink half an inch into mud.
I close on the wall.
My whole frame groans.
Rubble is swept aside by my wheels.

lines.zh: 我的遮蔽板挨着地面拖
lines.en: My roof panel drags along the ground.
I need only a straight path.
The ram log hangs still.
The ropes are taut, coil on coil.
I wait for the gate ahead.

lines.zh: 我身上的木头吸了雨水
lines.en: My timbers have drunk the rain.
A few roof planks have come loose.
The men pushing me are resting.
My wheels are stuck in the mud.

lines.zh: 我不发出声音,除非被推
lines.en: I make no sound unless pushed.
I stand in the shade.
The ram's head bears old marks.
My frame is thick enough to stop arrows.
So I wait.
There are shouts beyond the wall.
The wood dries slowly on me.
You stand in my track.
I am going through, and you are in the way.
You can still push me.

lines.zh: 把手放在横梁上,往那边
lines.en: Hands on the beam, that way.
You are taller, but lighter.
I only need to face the gate.
Do not stand before the ram.
Alone, you will not move me fast.
My wheels need clearing.
You have stepped through my roof.
You are deciding whether to use me.
Use me, and that gate will not hold.
My wood does not know faces.
Say push, and I go forward.
This angle is just right.

lines.zh: 你得先把我从泥里弄出来
lines.en: First you must get me out of the mud.
I am not particular about who pushes me.
Whoever pushes me, I break their gate.
A beam has cracked.
I am knocked off line.
A roof panel has come off.
My axle has slid out.
A rope has slipped a coil.
The timber is groaning.
I am tilted, but I can still move.
Someone must nail me together again.
I am far from falling apart.
That hit the load-bearing part.
This timber of mine does not eat grass.

lines.zh: 要是有人给它上油,我就能快些
lines.en: Oil my axle and I would move faster.
That in your hand is not for eating.

lines.zh: 我倒想要块新的遮蔽板
lines.en: A new roof plank would suit me better.

lines.zh: 木头渴了,但不是渴这个
lines.en: My timber thirsts, but not for that.
You would have to change my wheels.
I smell fresh timber.
That could shim my wheel.
I edge forward half an inch.
That hardly counts as pushing.
You struck my beam.
I am knocked off my line.
My frame held together.
My wheel caught you.
That stopped us both.
I must realign on the gate.
Wood on wood is very solid.
You are pushing the wrong way.
Do not push my flank.
Everyone behind, keep up.
I am a siege engine.
Such words are not mine.

lines.zh: 但我可以替你挡一会儿
lines.en: But I can shield you for a while.
Stand behind me and keep low.
My roof panel is wide enough.

lines.zh: 你推我到哪,我就守到哪
lines.en: Push me wherever, and I hold there.

lines.zh: 木头也有被推着走的一生
lines.en: Timber too has a life of being pushed.
Let us rest a while.
No gate to break tonight.
I will be right here.

lines.zh: 东西被塞进我的木架空隙里。
lines.en: The thing is stuffed into a gap in my timber frame.

lines.zh: 你把东西塞进我的架子
lines.en: You wedge it into my frame.
It is caught in my axle.
This could serve as a shim.
Not heavy; it can come along.
I have pressed it into the mud.
Take it; no use to me.
It is caught between my ropes.
Do not forget it on the frame.
This could stop an arrow.
The gate is right ahead.
I have aimed the ram.
Twenty paces to go.
I need everyone to push.

lines.zh: 墙上的箭挡不住我的顶板
lines.en: Arrows on the wall cannot pierce my roof.
Aim at the seam of the gate.
The first blow matters most.
Every part of me is locked.
Then push forward.
Raise the ram a little.
That stone is in the way.
There will be men behind the gate.
I do not care what comes after.
Ten paces further.
I will hit it square.
Stand clear; I am moving.
I press steadily at the gate.

lines.zh: 轮子转一圈,门就少一截
lines.en: Every wheel turn takes a piece of the gate.
I hear the timber creaking.
The gap is wider than before.
Those behind push in unison.
Arrows land on my roof.
I have not been stopped.

lines.zh: 这个角度还能再撞两下
lines.en: From this angle, two more blows will do.

lines.zh: 我的撞木已经荡起来了
lines.en: My ram has begun to swing.
The ground has not stopped shaking.
The shouts behind the gate are disordered.

lines.zh: 我的轮子过了最后一块石头
lines.en: My wheels pass the last stone.
Push a little further.
I am about to hit.
This rhythm works.
On three, again.
The hinge side is thinner; go there.
I hug the wall and hit again.
More stones fall on my roof.
Give me ten more paces of room.
The ram swings out at once.
A dull boom that reaches the bones.
The gate plank split on the spot.
My frame jolts backward.
Splinters and dust fall together.
Once more, and hard.
Rubble has fallen on my roof.
That blow bent the gatepost.
The recoil pushes me back half a foot.
The ram's head lost its paint.
The men inside have fallen back.
From here, two more.
I have not come apart yet.
The sound is heavier than my timber.
My wheels roll over the broken planks.
That gate has been broken open.
I need no second target.
The road ahead is open.
I am assembled on the dirt road.
The ram is hoisted on ropes.
The four beams come down.
My wheels touch ground for the first time.
The wall stands before me.
Someone starts the chant.
The timber smells fresh.
I am pushed forward ten paces.
My roof catches the first volley.
The ram is still swinging.
I stop and face the gate.
Then it starts at this gate.
My shadow falls across the gate.
The men who push me have gathered.
I am the heaviest piece of the column.
It will take twenty men.
Clear the way; the ram is coming.
The men behind the gate will hear me coming.
My roof panel is on fire.
I flip over with my frame.
All my timber is soaking up water.
A beam has been blown apart.
An arrow sticks in my roof.

lines.zh: 那股力量推着我自己往前走
lines.en: That force drags me forward on my own.

lines.zh: 没有推我的人,我寸步难行
lines.en: Without my crew, I cannot move.
Lightning strikes my ram.
My wheels cannot find the ground.
